headline: PSG lose three to injury, still favourites against Lyon
summary: PSG beat Barcelona, then lost three players in the same night. Kvaratskhelia ruptured his ACL and is out for the season; captain Marquinhos and Ousmane Dembélé were injured too, according to Sky Sports. Yet PSG have won five straight, scoring 16 goals, and on Sunday they host Lyon — both on 14 points at the top of Ligue 1. Lyon beat Nice 2-1 despite a red card. Across the market average, PSG's win chance slipped from 70.7% to 67.3%, but they are still rated 1.33 goals the stronger side. The Paris police have asked for the match to be postponed.
read: PSG meet Lyon at the top of Ligue 1, but they do it without Kvaratskhelia — out for the season with an ACL rupture — and fellow Barcelona casualties Marquinhos and Dembélé. The market still makes PSG clear favourites at 67.3% and rates them about 1.3 goals stronger, while the Paris police prefecture has asked for the match to be postponed.

facts.fact: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia ruptured the ACL in his right knee in the win over Barcelona and will undergo surgery, ending his season.
facts.meaning: PSG lose a first-choice wide attacker for the rest of the campaign, five days before this game.

facts.fact: Captain Marquinhos and Ousmane Dembélé were also injured in that same Champions League win over Barcelona.
facts.meaning: Three key players — a winger, the main forward and the captain at centre-back — lost in one night, a structural change rather than a rotation.

facts.fact: PSG's chance of winning fell from 70.7% to 67.3% in the last 24 hours.
facts.meaning: Still clear favourites, but the market has taken a slice off them before kick-off.

facts.fact: The Paris police prefecture has asked for this round-eight Ligue 1 fixture to be postponed, citing planned protests this weekend and the NFL game at the Stade de France on Sunday.
facts.meaning: The game is officially at risk of not being played at all — a bigger question than form or team news.

facts.fact: PSG have won all five of their last matches, scoring 16 goals.
facts.meaning: They arrive in top scoring form — the problem this week is who is available, not how they have been playing.

facts.fact: Lyon lead Ligue 1 on goal difference, level on 14 points with PSG after seven games.
facts.meaning: This is a genuine top-of-the-table clash, not a routine home fixture.

facts.fact: Lyon beat Nice 2-1 despite Nakamura's red card in the 70th minute.
facts.meaning: They arrive on four wins in five, having taken three points a man down — and likely without the dismissed Nakamura here.

facts.fact: The handicap fair line has PSG about 1.33 goals better than Lyon, with the main line at -1.25.
facts.meaning: The market sees a comfortable PSG win rather than a rout — roughly one and a third goals of superiority.

sources.fact: Khvicha Kvaratskhelia ruptured the ACL in his right knee in the win over Barcelona and will undergo surgery, ending his season.
PSG lost captain Marquinhos and Ousmane Dembele to injury in the same 4-2 Champions League win over Barcelona.
Luis Enrique said the injuries to Dembele, Kvaratskhelia and Marquinhos were the 'worst part of the game'.
PSG beat Barcelona 4-2 in the Champions League, their third win in three matches, which kept them top of the Champions League table.
The Spanish press praised PSG's performance against Barcelona and described the champion as being on another level and 'king of Europe'.
Barcelona reported PSG to UEFA over a tifo displayed before the Champions League match that they say incites violence and hatred.
Lyon beat Nice 2-1 despite having Nakamura sent off in the 70th minute and moved top of Ligue 1 on goal difference.
Lyon's win over Nice came after a Europa League victory over Crystal Palace.
